$comment: dd-ci-01 serves the org's pools again (14 Nov 2026, founder): CI-001, CI-022, CI-028 and CI-029 apply to org private repos as before. Hosted runners are still wanted where a job is registered here. Set self_hosted_retired back to true to stop the rules requiring the pools.

jobs.why: Keeps all four runner variables on GitHub-hosted runners and reports included-minute usage. It cannot select the retired servers (DOM-1079).

jobs.why: VoiceOver (Guidepup) needs macOS, which no Linux pool provides; the job stays hosted for as long as it exists (dd-agent-kit #298).
jobs.measured: not measured; runs on pull requests that touch the journey pack and on manual dispatch

jobs.why: Walks the site-teardown journey pack with macOS VoiceOver (Guidepup). It needs a real Mac; dd-ci-01 is Linux. Runs only on PRs that touch the journey pack, the screen-reader test or this workflow.
jobs.measured: estimate, not yet measured: about 15 minutes a run, about 2 runs a week, billed at the 10x macOS rate (ten included minutes per minute used); re-measure after a month
